visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Name the Magic Numbers with an Enum
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The numbers 0, 1 and 2 stand for machine states. Give them names with an enum and use a switch. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: STOPPED is readable where 2 is a mystery, and a typo in an enum name is a compile error while a wrong number is silently accepted.
